about: Remarks on the smaller moments (sim/moments.js): ducks, maidens, big overs, jaffas, weaknesses found.

bunnings: FIRST BALL. {b} WON'T WANT TO SEE THAT AGAIN.
A GOLDEN DUCK. THE LONG WALK FEELS LONGER.
FIRST BALL. A SHORT VISIT.

GONE FIRST BALL! WHAT A START FOR {w}!
GONE FIRST BALL! WHAT A DELIVERY!
grog: {w} HAD A PLAN FOR {b} FROM BALL ONE. EXECUTED.
NO TIME TO SETTLE. THAT'S WHY YOU ATTACK A NEW BATTER.
FIRST BALL. A NEW BATTER IS ALWAYS VULNERABLE. THAT'S WHY YOU ATTACK.

{b} BATTLED {n} BALLS FOR NO RUN.

HAD THAT HIT, HE WAS GONE.

SO CLOSE! A DIRECT HIT AND HE WAS GONE!
grog: THE RIGHT IDEA TO SHY. THE BACKING UP WAS THE PROBLEM.
WORTH THE SHY AT THAT RANGE. THE BATTERS TOOK A BIG RISK.

{b} HAS TAKEN THE INITIATIVE. THREE ON THE BOUNCE.
THREE IN A ROW. {w} NEEDS A CHANGE OF ENDS, OR A REST.

TWO IN A ROW.
TWO IN A ROW. {w} IS NOT ENJOYING THIS.

BACK TO BACK! THE CROWD IS UP!

BACK TO BACK. THAT CHANGES THE MOOD OF THE OVER.

BACK TO BACK. NOW THE CAPTAIN HAS TO MOVE A MAN BACK.

{b} ON {n}. THE FIELD WILL COME IN TO STOP THE SINGLES.
{n} FOR {b}. THE FIELD WILL COME IN TO DENY THE SINGLES.

{n} ON THE BOARD.

{n} RUNS. ONE OVER LIKE THAT SWINGS THE MOMENTUM.

{n} RUNS. THE CAPTAIN HAS TO PROTECT {w} WITH THE FIELD NOW.

ANOTHER MAIDEN! THE BATTERS CAN'T GET HIM AWAY!
ANOTHER MAIDEN! THIS IS A STRANGLEHOLD!
